title: IBPS SO Prelims Mock Test - Quantitative Aptitude

questions.direction: Solve the following arithmetic expression.
Solve the following arithmetic expression.
Solve the following ratio problem.
questions.text: The ratio of the incomes of A and B is 7 : 5. If their total income is Rs. 14,400, what is the income of A?

questions.direction: Solve the following simple interest problem.
questions.text: Find the simple interest on Rs. 8,000 at 7.5% per annum for 2 years.

questions.direction: Solve the following compound interest problem.
questions.text: What is the compound interest on Rs. 10,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually?

questions.direction: Solve the following average problem.
questions.text: The average of 5 numbers is 42. If a sixth number is added, the average becomes 45. Find the sixth number.
questions.explanation: Sum of first 5 numbers = 5 × 42 = 210. Sum of 6 numbers = 6 × 45 = 270. Sixth number = 270 - 210 = 60.

questions.direction: Solve the following profit and loss problem.
questions.text: An article is sold for Rs. 960 at a profit of 20%. Find its cost price.
questions.explanation: SP = 120% of CP. Therefore, CP = 960 × 100/120 = Rs. 800.

questions.direction: Solve the following discount problem.
questions.text: A shopkeeper offers a discount of 20% on the marked price of an article. If the selling price is Rs. 1,440, find the marked price.
questions.explanation: Selling price = 80% of marked price. Marked price = 1440 × 100/80 = Rs. 1,800.

questions.direction: Solve the following time and distance problem.
questions.text: A train 180 metres long is travelling at a speed of 54 km/hr. How much time will it take to cross a pole?

questions.direction: Solve the following boat and stream problem.
questions.text: The downstream speed of a boat is 18 km/hr and its upstream speed is 10 km/hr. What is the speed of the boat in still water?
questions.explanation: Speed in still water = (Downstream speed + Upstream speed)/2 = (18 + 10)/2 = 14 km/hr.

questions.direction: Solve the following time and work problem.
questions.text: A can complete a work in 12 days and B can complete the same work in 18 days. In how many days will they complete the work together?
questions.explanation: A's one-day work = 1/12 and B's = 1/18. Together = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36. Time = 36/5 = 7.2 days.

questions.direction: Solve the following pipes and cisterns problem.
questions.text: Pipe A can fill a tank in 15 minutes and Pipe B can fill it in 20 minutes. If both pipes are opened together, how long will they take to fill the tank?

questions.direction: Solve the following age problem.
questions.text: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 3 : 5. If their total age is 64 years, what is the difference between their ages?
questions.explanation: Total ratio = 8. One part = 64/8 = 8. Difference = (5 - 3) × 8 = 16 years.

questions.direction: Solve the following mixture problem.
questions.text: Milk and water are mixed in the ratio 5 : 3. If the total quantity of the mixture is 64 litres, how much milk is present?

questions.direction: Solve the following time and distance problem.
questions.text: A person travels a certain distance at 45 km/hr and takes 1 hour more than when travelling at 60 km/hr. Find the distance.
questions.explanation: Let distance be D. D/45 - D/60 = 1. Therefore, D(1/45 - 1/60) = 1. D × 1/180 = 1, so D = 180 km.

questions.direction: Solve the following HCF and LCM problem.
questions.text: The HCF of two numbers is 12 and their product is 864. If one number is 24, find the other number.
questions.explanation: Using Product = HCF × LCM, LCM = 864/12 = 72. Since 24 × other number = HCF × LCM = 864, the other number is 36.

questions.direction: Solve the following number system problem.
questions.text: Find the smallest number which when divided by 12, 18 and 24 leaves a remainder of 5 in each case.

questions.direction: Solve the following percentage problem.
questions.text: The price of an article increases from Rs. 500 to Rs. 575. What is the percentage increase?

questions.direction: Solve the following income and expenditure problem.
questions.text: A person's monthly income is Rs. 50,000 and he saves 20% of his income. If his income increases by 10% and his expenditure increases by 5%, what will be his new monthly savings?
questions.explanation: Original expenditure = 80% of 50,000 = Rs. 40,000. New income = Rs. 55,000. New expenditure = 40,000 × 105/100 = Rs. 42,000. New savings = 55,000 - 42,000 = Rs. 13,000.

questions.direction: Study the following number series and answer the question.
questions.text: Find the missing number: 5, 11, 23, 47, 95, ?
questions.explanation: Each number is multiplied by 2 and then 1 is added: 5 × 2 + 1 = 11, 11 × 2 + 1 = 23, and so on. Therefore, 95 × 2 + 1 = 191.

questions.text: x² - 11x + 28 = 0. What are the values of x?

questions.direction: Solve the following approximation problem.
questions.text: What is the approximate value of 49.98% of 800 + 24.96% of 600?

questions.direction: Solve the following probability problem.
questions.text: A bag contains 5 red, 4 blue and 3 green balls. One ball is drawn at random. What is the probability that the ball is either red or blue?

questions.direction: Study the following data carefully and answer the question.
questions.text:
Number of candidates appearing for an examination:

2022: 800
2023: 1000
2024: 1200
2025: 1500

What is the percentage increase in the number of candidates from 2023 to 2025?

questions.direction: Study the following data carefully and answer the question.
questions.text:
Number of questions attempted by a student in five sections:

English = 18
Reasoning = 22
Quantitative Aptitude = 25
General Awareness = 15
Professional Knowledge = 30

What percentage of the total questions attempted were from Quantitative Aptitude?
questions.explanation: Total questions attempted = 18 + 22 + 25 + 15 + 30 = 110. Quantitative Aptitude questions = 25. Percentage = 25/110 × 100 = 22.73% approximately.
